name: Ring Mail
description:
Heavy metal rings are sewn onto a reinforced garment, spreading its weight across the shoulders.

Uses the 2014 AC, Dexterity limit, Strength requirement and Stealth disadvantage where applicable. Sold as one complete, nonmagical suit; fitting is a separate service.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for one complete item; 80% of the 2014 baseline.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
source.reference: SRD 5.1 (2014), Equipment; native field mapping checked against D&D5e release-5.3.3. Original description and adjusted weight. See docs/BLACKSMITH_GUIDE.md.
